prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create FROM SCRATCH a new single 2D game relic icon: Junna Hoshimi's intact green gemstone at the end of her bow, for the starter relic "绿色宝石".
The supplied images are ORIGINAL ANIME DESIGN REFERENCES only. Image 1 shows the official bow gemstone enlargement; image 2 shows its actual green color in the anime character art. Use neither their white paper backgrounds nor the mounting as part of the output. This is a fresh illustration, not an edit or variation of any earlier generated image.
Subject: ONLY the intact detached gemstone, a compact almost-round broad oval convex gem, a rounded polygon rather than an egg or teardrop. Follow the original radial, slightly irregular triangular facet arrangement: slim triangular facets gather around a slightly off-center pinwheel reflection; the outer crown facets are larger. A shallow visible dark lower-right side gives it real gem thickness. A calm stable unbroken outline, slightly wider across the middle and very subtly leaning left. Avoid a conventional long pointed diamond silhouette or rectangular step cut.
Render as polished hand-painted fantasy roguelike inventory art with anime-like decisive shading: clean dark forest-green contour, rich emerald body, contrasting deep green side planes, restrained mint and pale green broad highlights. Light comes from upper left. Gem is dark green enough for depth, with around twenty clearly organized facets, very little texture. Only one small pale reflective glint; no white star symbol drawn on the surface. Shape and green facet planes should read at 32px.
Composition: one centered isolated gem, fills about 76% of the square canvas height, generous 10% transparent margin all around, slight three-quarter view with broad face visible.
Background: true transparent alpha, no environment or floor.
Absolutely exclude all mounts, bases, sockets, gold, metal, bow pieces, handles, ropes, leaves, jewelry loops, chains, crowns, fire, detached sparkles, text, frames, and shadows outside the object. Only the green mineral gemstone.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Create FROM SCRATCH a new standalone 2D game relic icon for Junna Hoshimi's upgraded relic "燃烧宝石", based on the irregular gemstone on her SHORT BLADE in Revue Starlight. This must be a freshly drawn object using only the original anime references, not an edit of or lighting variant on any earlier generated icon.
Input 1 is the official MOVIE SHORT-BLADE GEM ENLARGEMENT. Its notes call for an IRREGULAR, PROTRUDING, LUMPY shape. Look at the exposed crystalline gemstone at the TOP of the enlarged detail: uneven broken polygon edges, asymmetrically raised crystalline faces, a crooked blunt high point and irregular small angular recesses. The blue-gray wrapped cylinder BELOW is the sword handle: exclude that handle completely. Input 2 gives the actual green mineral color of Junna's gemstone, only as a color reference.
Draw ONLY the detached green gem as a compact three-dimensional uneven fragment / nugget. A squat broad irregular silhouette, visibly thicker and more rugged than an orderly polished jewel; several large off-axis fractured facets bulge forward, one side rises higher, 2-3 chipped edge notches, a raw uneven broken lower edge. It is ONE connected coherent gemstone, NOT a pile of separate shards, not a long quartz point, and not a symmetrical oval brilliant-cut gem. The gemstone's fractured irregular topology is the main identifying feature.
Style: clean hand-painted fantasy roguelike inventory illustration with decisive anime-like planes and a dark emerald outline; substantial high-contrast facets, very little surface texture, readable at 32px. Deep saturated emerald-green sides, vivid fresh green core, a few luminous mint and pale lime fractured facets. A concentrated irregular mint-white shine inside a small exposed break suggests burning brilliance, green light runs across 2-3 planes; keep most of the gem strongly green and dimensional, not white. A very thin close-fitting translucent green glow is acceptable; keep silhouette clear, no detached particles or star symbols. No literal flames.
Composition: isolated object centered on a square transparent canvas, fills about 76% of its height, 10% clear margin, three-quarter view exposing front and one side.
Strict exclusions: NO metal, socket, base, stand, bands, wrapping, grip, sword, bow, gold, gray material, jewelry setting, chain, loose fragments, surrounding objects, orange fire, frame, text, backdrop, floor shadow. Only the irregular green mineral gemstone described above. True transparent alpha.
